conditions: Built browser edition on static Vite preview, isolated fresh Playwright contexts. IndexedDB/service-worker real interactions, synthetic binary WAV fixture, no cloud backend or live AI. Automated axe default Home states; not real-device or WCAG certification.

checks.name: Service worker initializes real browser storage before UI; status is honest
Home → conversation → native Canvas → save revision → reload retains edit
Two simultaneous writes with one revision: one commits, stale write gets 409
Actual binary WAV persists as Blob and is returned by stable /api/assets URL
Local Agent tool executes and saves; connected mode without fallback remains unavailable
Trash and restore preserve stable identity
Backup → empty browser context → restore: exact records/IDs, three revisions and media survive
Invalid backup rejected without modifying stored records
